meta.title: CAPEX Epic Progress

meta.codexRule: When a CAPEX task is completed, set status: DONE, add completed_at in ISO 8601 timezone form, add completion/closeout evidence, and regenerate this progress data in the same change.

activationBlockers.plain: Repeated button presses can accidentally do the same work twice.
activationBlockers.action: Check whether the action was already recorded before doing the work again.

activationBlockers.plain: A document history link can point to the wrong project.
activationBlockers.action: Confirm the document and project belong together before saving the link.

activationBlockers.plain: An official-selection history entry can point to a document from another project.
activationBlockers.action: Confirm the selected document and the project match before recording the selection.

activationBlockers.plain: The risk/CEO view can look finished before the risk workflow is ready.
activationBlockers.action: Show it as blocked until the risk workflow closes.
